responsibility: Provides the ELF-specific configuration layer shared by NetBSD ELF targets. It defines NetBSD ELF OS builtins, startup and endfile specs using crtbegin/crtend variants, the ELF linker spec with entry-point and dynamic-linker handling, the standard set of NetBSD extra specs exported to the specs engine, and optional --as-needed libgcc_s behavior. This header is the NetBSD-on-ELF link/spec companion to the more general netbsd.h base configuration.
same_name_distinction: This is the spec/macro header for the netbsd-elf pair: it defines ELF-specific startup, endfile, linker, and extra-spec strings for NetBSD targets, whereas gcc/config/netbsd-elf.opt only declares the small set of driver options (-rdynamic and -rpath=) that those specs accept.
